name: validate_workflow
description: Validate workflow structure, connections, and expressions. Pass workflow object. MUST have: {"workflow": {"nodes": [array of node objects], "connections": {object with node connections}}}. Each node needs: name, type, typeVersion, position.

workflow.description: Object with two required fields: nodes (array) and connections (object). Example: {"nodes": [{"name": "Webhook", "type": "n8n-nodes-base.webhook", "typeVersion": 2, "position": [250, 300], "parameters": {}}], "connections": {}}

validateNodes.description: Validate individual node configurations. Default true.

validateConnections.description: Validate node connections and flow. Default true.

validateExpressions.description: Validate n8n expressions syntax and references. Default true.

profile.description: Validation profile for node validation. Default "runtime".

options.description: Optional object. Example: {"validateNodes": true, "validateConnections": true, "validateExpressions": true, "profile": "runtime"}
